name: therapist
description: Voice-first peer-support agent bundle — explicitly NOT a therapist replacement. Listens, runs validated screeners (PHQ-9 / GAD-7), surfaces escalation paths to real clinicians for any moderate-or-above band or crisis-language detection. Demonstrates the agent-runtime substrate composing with phony-voice + clinical-screeners + structured-output-blocks layers on the Tangle floor.
